description: AICTIONBOT™ Category Profile by KULIC Advisory. From your own spend rows and, if present, your contract list it builds one file for a category: total and share of spend, suppliers with their share, concentration, small orders, monthly course, contracts with the last day to give notice, and the levers that follow. Rows without a category get a suggested one from supplier name and text. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Requests without sign-in are limited to 20 KB.

category.description: Category to profile. Default: the largest category in the data.

contracts.description: Optional contracts: supplier, subject, end (date), notice (e.g. 3 months), auto_renewal (yes/no), category.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

spend.description: Spend rows: supplier, amount, date (YYYY-MM-DD or DD.MM.YYYY), category (optional), text (optional), document (optional).

name: build_category_profile
title: Build a category profile from a spend list and contracts: volume, suppliers, concentration, next notice date, levers
